class.name: GameplaySubsystemRegistry
class.brief_description: Owns and orders gameplay subsystems for one lifetime scope.
class.description: GameplaySubsystemRegistry enforces unique subsystem IDs and a common scope. It initializes subsystems in registration order and deinitializes them in reverse order, including when the registry is freed. Repeated initialize or deinitialize calls are safe outside lifecycle callbacks. Nested registry lifecycle transitions from initialization or deinitialization callbacks are rejected.

method.name: add_subsystem
method.description: Registers a matching-scope subsystem with a unique, non-empty ID. Services added by an initialization callback are initialized after the services registered before them, preserving registration order.

method.name: deinitialize_subsystems
method.description: Deinitializes all registered subsystems in reverse order. Calling this while inactive has no effect.

method.name: get_subsystem
method.description: Returns the live subsystem with [param id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_subsystems
method.description: Returns live subsystems in registration order.

method.name: initialize_subsystems
method.description: Initializes all subsystems in registration order. Already-initialized registries return [constant OK]. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if called from another subsystem lifecycle transition.

method.name: remove_subsystem
method.description: Deinitializes and removes [param subsystem] if it is registered.

members.member: The lifetime scope accepted by this registry.

signal.name: subsystem_added
signal.description: Emitted after a subsystem is registered.

signal.name: subsystem_removed
signal.description: Emitted after a subsystem is removed.
